description_en: Retrieve details about a site's custom response code configuration
description_zh: 查询站点的修改响应码配置详情
name: GetCustomResponseCodeRule

parameters.help_en: Site ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html
parameters.name: site_id

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:

global: Global configuration.

rule: Rule configuration
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型。取值范围：
global：全局配置。
rule：规则配置

Rule.description_en:
The rule content. Use conditional expressions to match user requests. Do not set this parameter when adding a global configuration. There are two scenarios:

Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.

Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq "video.example.com")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. Do not set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:

on: Enable.

off: Disable
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. Do not set this parameter when adding a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates higher execution priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version control enabled, use this parameter to specify the site version where the configuration takes effect. The default is version 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
